description: Each month, holds the 2 strongest of /ES, /NQ, /RTY, /YM, FDAX, Euro Stoxx 50 and Nikkei 225 futures by 6-month return. Backtested on FinzData futures: each market is its front-month contract rolled on the FinzData roll calendar, as an excess-return index (no interest on collateral), 5 bps costs per trade, re-run free on full history.
title: Equity index futures rotation · 6-month momentum · top 2 of 7
